briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 accelerate multi-agent capabilities as US-China compute restrictions tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 11 new models this month with rapid gains in agentic reasoning. US export controls on advanced chips to China remain the dominant geopolitical constraint. Global AI investment hit $11.9B in Q2.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with native multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind launched Gemini 3; Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B; xAI shipped Grok-4; DeepSeek-V3 set new efficiency benchmarks. Reasoning benchmarks improved 18% month-over-month.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reached 1.2M units; Microsoft and Google announced 50GW data center expansions; TSMC Arizona fab began 3nm AI chip production; Saudi Arabia committed $40B to sovereign AI infrastructure.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier systems before 2027?
